status: Functional cast for integration; looks await the user's art approval.

unity_import.fbx: Scale 1, forward -Z, up Y (Blender export axis_forward=-Z, axis_up=Y, FBX_SCALE_UNITS). Rig: Humanoid. Build each family Avatar once from the existing creator FBX / unity-humanoid-map.json and use Copy From Other Avatar for every look and part of that family. Meshes named <look>_LOD0/_LOD1/_LOD2 in <look>.fbx create a LODGroup automatically; <look>_Hero.fbx is the near/creator tier.
unity_import.textures: BaseColor sRGB; Normal = tangent-space OpenGL (+Y), import as Normal Map; MetallicSmoothness linear (R metal, A smoothness), disable sRGB, alpha is data (not transparency); Emission sRGB when present. URP/Lit opaque, one material per look.
unity_import.scale: Per-look uniform root scale for height variety is in looks[*].scale (skeleton unchanged).
unity_import.runtime_parts: art/cast/export/parts/<fam>/parts.json: every part on the same rig, slot UVs in a fixed 8x8 atlas layout. Merge chosen parts into one SkinnedMeshRenderer, copy each part's slot texture rect into one atlas (Graphics.CopyTexture), drop body chunks listed in hides_body_regions, tint by the Mask sub ids.
